run_word_alignment: run RCSLS supervised word alignment between source and target embeddings using a bilingual dictionary
run_alignment_with_sgd: run word alignment with SGD optimization using a specified batch size and learning rate
run_alignment_spectral: run word alignment with spectral projection constraints on the transformation matrix
run_alignment_centered: run word alignment with centered embeddings by passing the center flag
run_alignment_save_output: run word alignment and save aligned embeddings and transformation matrix to output files
